name: Applause E Randolph
original_name: アプローズ=E=ランドルフ
source:
[i]"Please allow me to serve you with sincere devotion."[/i]

The eldest daughter of the former Duke Randolph. For a certain reason, her family escaped from Rowan, and lived in a village deep in the mountains.

As a result of her family, and all those around her being murdered, she vows to take revenge on those who took everything from her. She now always carries herself with a face void of emotion. In her pursuit of revenge, she makes a contract with Oberon to strengthen her faesight hand.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/mistonia/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
